why.title: Why I built this
why.description: The motivation and philosophy behind this project
why.problemIntro: Once you have a big collection of AV codes, you'll probably run into these:
why.problem1: Video sites keep changing domains or shutting down, breaking your saved links
why.problem2: Collections scattered across platforms are hard to manage
why.problem3: Sharing a list is awkward when everyone uses a different site
why.problem4: There's no simple way to organize and search your collection
why.solutionIntro: This project puts the code first, so you can:
why.solution1: Save only the codes, independent of any specific site
why.solution2: Move between video sites whenever you like
why.solution3: Share a code list and let friends pick their own site
why.solution4: Create as many playlists as you need
why.tech: Built with Next.js 15. Works without signing in.
